author: National Geographic
description:
In this Uncharted MEGA Episode, celebrity chef, Gordon Ramsay, travels to different corners of the United States of America to unlock the secrets of regional and unique cuisines. His journey takes him to the Alaska Panhandle to learn how to cook seal with a native Tlingit elder, to Michigan's Upper Peninsula to spearfish in Lake Superior, and to Maine, 'the lobster capital of the world.' Featuring three, full episodes:

Alaska's Panhandle - 00:00 
Chef Gordon Ramsay journeys to the rugged Alaskan Panhandle to unlock the secrets of Alaskan cuisine. On his adventure, he learns how to cook seal with a native Tlingit elder, climbs a sheer rock face in a snowstorm and goes grouse hunting before putting his newfound knowledge to the test at a feast with legendary local chef Lionel Uddipa.
